notes: «و رُوِيَ» is the passive verb of transmission, not a name; the Imam written after «عن» inside the chain stays a narrator (owner ruling 2)

fixes.reason: RWY reads the verb «روي» as the first narrator; in the text it is the passive verb of «و رُوِيَ عَنْ».

evidence.quote: وَ رُوِيَ عَنْ رَوْحِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحِيمِ
